en: The Secret Seal of the Common Root of Thirty Thousand Buddhas, together with the Dharma of the Most Honored King of the Dragon Lineage;
the Buddha-light is purple, and [the remaining characters are illegible].
□□□□□□□ years are transformed into shooting stars. Shooting stars for a thousand years □□□□□□□□□□□□□□□□□ become floating water.
When gold enters water, it does not diminish;
on the contrary, it increases [its luster]. ... This is the method of the Flying Immortals (fei-xian) of the Great Clarity (Taiqing).

Do not [consume] two sheng of wine mixed with *fuling* (pachyma cocos) [as follows]. This is the method for attaining immortality by abstaining from grain. Regarding the method of *tila* (sesame): it is called the "Noble Glory of the Three Luminaries."
One is named □□□□□□□□□□□□□□□Chāng; one is named Hán-yìng; and one is named Qīng-xiāng.
Regarding these leaves for consumption: [take] those that are well-ripened, pound them, and remove the soil and impurities.
Then, according to one's preference, [add] hot water [in whatever quantity is desired]. After they have dried, steam them.
Cause the subtle breath to emerge until it flows through to the extremities and comes to rest.
Furthermore, [fill in the missing text]... every time it reaches the period of steaming, one must ensure there is bright sunshine;
if the sky is overcast, [it will not work].
One must not [allow it to dry out]; rather, one should repeatedly warm and steam it.
Once it is completely softened, one should then pound it and mix it with white honey.
When it is time to take [the medicine], take one pill per dose; take it three times a day.
To achieve longevity and immortality: on the day of the upper *hai* (癸亥) in the eleventh month, collect ripe and high-quality *huai* (槐) seeds.
Place them in yellow cloth... [and] consume them.
On the hundredth day, one observes the celestial phenomena.
On the two-hundredth [day], one takes one dose of the "Initial Garment" (*chūfuk*).
Furthermore, on the tenth month, one gathers three *shō* of *huai* seeds and [takes] three doses. After one year, the night [symptoms] vanish; after two years, all myriad ailments are eliminated.
Wear this for three [periods]... [it makes one] clear-sighted... take thirty *jin* of *zhānglù* roots, remove the impurities... dry in the shade for sixty days.

Take seven *fūnchǐ* (square inches) of powdered *mòshāi* [māṣa]; within seven days, one will obtain treasures without difficulty. One can travel a thousand *lǐ* in a single day. This golden method is not transmitted [lightly]. To eliminate the three *pí* (corpse-demons), always use [the powder] with yellow [pigment].

Take realgar and [the other ingredients] in equal parts and grind them into a powder. Wrap this in cotton... [omitted] ...one who is about to die will emerge from death and live for five hundred years. Furthermore, [mix this] with wine.
On the day of the "Breaking and Dispelling" (*po-ch'u*) in the eighth month, mix the medicine with [ingredients]... [omitted] ...and one will be cured of a hundred ailments.
If taken for three periods, the ears and eyes will become sharp and clear... [omitted] ...and one will share in the same radiance.
The upper corpse [remains] for one hundred days;
the middle corpse, for sixty days; the lower [corpse], for fifty days... [the size of] a chicken egg. This refers to the upper corpse.
The middle corpse is black; the lower corpse... [observes] the transgressions of people.
An offering was presented to the Heavenly Elder (Tianweng).

In this world, [the text is obscured], yet by the power of its medicinal essence, it causes the hundred ailments of men not to be cured... [the text is obscured]. If the five colors do not depart, and the three corpses (san shi) remain, [the text is obscured]... the Immortal shares the same radiance as the sun and moon; do not look upon it.
Furthermore, there is another method for those of inferior capacity:
on the seventeenth day of the seventh month,
remove the fingernails and toenails and swallow them.
To expel the three *śi* demons from within the abdomen... [text missing]. Another method:
Take five *sheng* of *wutí* (Cyperus rotundus) and four *liang* of dried firewood.
If one takes the root of *Gouqi* (Cuscuta) with [four] *xuan* of [water] and [four] *xuan* of *xuanhua* water, consuming it once a day,
after five days the three corpses (*trisira*) and insects will emerge from the lower part of the body. One must protect oneself against them.
After three days, it will naturally improve;
there is no need for further precautions. [Offer] Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva eight crabs and half a sheng of high-quality wine.
At the end of □□□□□, □□□□□□’s physical body travels ten thousand *li* in a single day;
even a galloping horse cannot catch up with him. From the time he began his practice through countless eons (*kalpas*), we have never seen anyone like him.

The recitation of [the name of] □□□□□□□□□□□□□□□□ causes people to fall into doubt and delusion. To gather yellow essence (huángjīng) □□□□□□□□□□□□□□□□□, wash away the coarse skin and hair, and finely chop one *shí* of it, boil it until □□□□□□□□□□□□□□. Mix the yellow powder with it to form cakes; consume one daily, the size of a chicken egg □□□□□□□□□□□□□□□, and one will not grow old.
One's intelligence will increase ten-thousandfold.
It will be equal to Heaven and Earth... [text missing] ...pound it thoroughly and boil with one *shí* of water.
Furthermore, take hemp seeds [and other ingredients] and form them into pills the size of a chicken egg;
take three pills daily.
After ten days, [take it]... for one hundred days. All myriad ailments will be eliminated;
within two or three months, one shall ascend to heaven. [Take] fresh [ingredients], pound them raw, and mix with one *sheng* of the yellow powder of raw soybeans to form cakes as usual.
Using the furnace... [omitted] ...one should consume one pill.
On the following day, three pills; gradually, one will no longer feel hunger.
By the tenth day... [omitted] ...sleeping naturally occurs, and food is no longer required.
After one year, it ascends... [illegible characters] ... Huangjing (Yellow Essence); its second name is Chonglou (Layered Tower), and its third name is Xianren (Immortal).

Regarding the "surplus grain" [blank]: among the plants produced by Heaven and Earth, there is one that, if eaten, causes [the practitioner] to [blank]. Its name is Huangjing; if one consumes it as food, [it bestows longevity].

Therefore, to transcend the world... [text missing] ...if one enters its mouth, one dies immediately. If a person believes in [the practice of] blowing and kissing, it will wound... [text missing] ...perhaps it is the essence of a herb whose leaves resemble bamboo... [text missing] ...One should gather it in the second, eighth, or third month... [text missing] ...it is forbidden to eat plums.
One who abstains from grain does not hunger. [The remaining characters are illegible. Roast the large black beans.
Take each of these six ingredients in five *he* measures and pound them into a fine powder.
Take one *jin* of white honey and [the aforementioned ingredients], kneading them into pills the size of plum fruits.
Consume them all at once;
this will ensure that one never suffers from hunger or thirst. All of these must be prepared when the weather is clear and bright.
First, one should purify the mind and observe the fast.

Bathe in fragrant water and [prepare] the elixir of the immortals by compounding the ingredients. Furthermore, regarding the method for subduing the Three Corpses (*trisava*): take the root of *vṛścika-danta* (wolf-tooth), dry it, and consume it.
One side measures one *cun* and seven *fen*.
On the day of the three-fold clarity, the *chong* (worm) descends. One obtains [blank] *liang* of *ma* seeds, two *sheng*.
Take one *sheng* or more of soybeans; for winter, take hemp seeds [prepared as follows]. Roast the hemp seeds as well, then grind them together into a powder.
Transcribe [the text] one day at a time; after consuming it for one year, one will travel a thousand li per day.
Five kinds of fungi (wǔzhī), [blank], bird [blank], [blank], and half a jin of fu ling;
four liang of pepper;
half a [blank] of tin; and two he of honey.
Instruct [the recipient] to take three pills daily at sunrise, noon, and the hour of Shen (5–7 p.m.).
Within three years, his graying hair will turn black again, and his strength will pervade the void.
Traveling a thousand li, Wang Qiao [prepared] five jin of [medicinal herbs].
Three shi of water were used;
it was cooked by gradually adding water at the mouth of the cauldron.
One may bring it to one *sheng* and place it in a vessel of fine quality.
Furthermore, one places one *sheng* of white honey inside and boils it again over a double layer of boiling water.
When five *sheng* [of liquid] overflow and surge with spontaneous mastery, [it is complete].
The Secret Seal and Dharma of the Fundamental Root of Thirty Thousand Buddhas.

Thus have I heard: at one time the Buddha was dwelling in the Heaven of Control over Others' Emanations, together with various great bodhisattvas, hundreds [of thousands], who had transcended the world.
Their names were: the Bodhisattva Totality-Holding Deva, the Bodhisattva Space, and the Bodhisattva Filling-Brightness... [omitted].
The Bodhisattva Immeasurable Banner, the Bodhisattva Immeasurable Body, and the Bodhisattva Vajra [Name].
Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva,
and Vasubandhu Bodhisattva.
The Bodhisattva Tianjin, the Bodhisattva [Name], the Bodhisattva Haiyan, the Bodhisattva [Name], Mañjuśrī Bodhisattva, and others.
There were [certain] great bodhisattva-mahāsattvas;
there were immeasurable śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas; and there were faithful sons of noble family and daughters of noble family.
He circumambulated the Buddha one hundred times and remained silent. At that time,
the World-Honored One, the Dragon-Species Superior King Buddha, was adorned with all manner of splendors.
Accompanied by three hundred and twenty trillion mantra-holders, Śakras, Brahmās, and other such classes of beings, together with their retinues,
they surrounded him on all sides, both before and behind.
Various [beings] scattered flowers, and fragrant winds blew through the forests,
pervading everywhere.
Radiant light shone forth,
and the earth shook in six ways;
he traveled through various lands and arrived at his own celestial palace.
The twenty-eight celestial realms, as well as all the suns, moons, and stars,
were simultaneously eclipsed and became invisible;
even the majestic radiance of the Bodhisattva, who had transformed this realm of Īśvara Heaven into gold, was completely outshone.
At that time, that Buddha, the Honored King of the Naga Lineage,
went to the place where the Tathāgata was and offered him boundless greetings and inquiries after his well-being.
Rising from his seat, he faced [the Buddha].
At that time, he addressed the Buddha, saying:
"World-Honored One."
"Throughout immeasurable kalpas, I have cultivated and accumulated [the Dharma]... [omitted] ...now I desire to honor the Great Dharma.
May the Buddha, out of his great compassion, [grant me his] voice... [omitted] "...so he spoke."
Excellent, excellent!
Since you have been able to resolve your mind [to seek enlightenment], speak now quickly.
I and all the Great Tathāgatas of the ten directions shall assist you in proclaiming this transformation.
At that time, King-Upper Buddha further declared: "There is a divine seal.
From the Buddhas of the past to the Buddhas of the future—more than thirty thousand in number—all have attained the unsurpassed path and ultimate nirvana by means of this seal."
World-Honored One,
as for those who have not yet attained the state of an Arhat or a Pratyekabuddha,
as well as the inferior class of ordinary beings who have first resolved their minds [upon enlightenment].

If one seeks the various great esoteric arts (*mahāvidyā*) and desires sovereign mastery, one should first take a piece of *ruyaśa* wood—one inch and eight *fen* square (this is called red willow wood).

By carving a seal from it and wearing it, thousands of spirits will manifest and ten thousand arts will spontaneously be mastered. Regarding the *Nāgarājottama-rāja-buddha*, the foremost of dharmas: first, establish the altar.
Every third day, one shall go to the latrine once and bathe once;
thereafter, one shall perform the ritual marking (kṣepa-mudrā). One performs the ritual marking while holding fragrant water in the mouth.

The mantra says: *Vīye timitavindate svāhā*. Visualize the Dragon-Species Supreme Honored King. May all vows be universally fulfilled; may [they] quickly [be realized]. [Diagram] ○ Seek ○ Seek □ Seek ○ Seek ○ World-Honored One, if there are any sons or daughters of good family...
If one seeks immeasurable hundreds of thousands of millions of secret arts,
one should immediately form this mudrā, fold it into a pouch,
and place it upon the shoulder.
Do not allow it to become defiled.
Wherever you may dwell—whether walking, sitting, or lying down—it shall never be an obstacle.
Constantly recite my name: *Namo Longzhongjiewangfo* (Homage to the Buddha King of the Dragon Lineage).

One must always keep this in mind. Regarding the first method for sealing with the Buddha *Nāgavṛṣabharāja*, the World-Honored One, at the moment of sealing, remains silent and ceases all speech; having sealed it, one should then make a vow.
Thereafter, one shall receive the seal.
On the day the seal is received, I and the fourfold assembly, together with all the mantra-holders... [at] dusk, one shall receive it.
The First Section on the Phenomenal Manifestations for Testing Efficacy While Wearing the Seal of the Buddha Nāgottamarāja. World-Honored One,
if one wishes to wear it,
it is stated briefly as follows:
That seal manifests many holy signs and few efficacious effects. Having spoken these words, he immediately lay down.
If there is an ordinary person of superior class and sharp faculties, at the side of the white head, there are three black maṇi-heart-essence medicinal pills.
If there are base-class ordinary persons,
then at the hour of midnight there shall be the sounding of a bell;
if [there are] such-and-such ordinary persons...
Then a distinct fragrance will come before them.
This occurs for those of sharp faculties;
for those of middling faculties, it occurs after three days.
When you obtain the medicine, do not let outsiders perceive it;
swallow it in a single breath.
That person will then occupy the same rank as the Dhāraṇī Bodhisattva.
Once these signs have been obtained, one may then test the art of seals when the days are complete.
This is the first method for testing the efficacy of the seals. World-Honored One!
If one wears this, it will exert its efficacy. When wishing to test it,
take seven cloves of clove (*karpūra*) and seal them with the mudrā.
Crush each [ingredient] separately,
swallow it with water,
and in a short while one will obtain the knowledge of others' minds (*paracittajñāna*). If one wishes to seek the knowledge of others' minds:
Furthermore, take two *jātī* (cloves) and swallow them dry.
Immediately seal the mouth three times with the mudrā;
one will instantly attain the knowledge of others' minds (*paracittajñāna*).
To foreknow the events of three lifetimes:
another method is to take a single human skull and,
regardless of its condition, stamp it seven times with the seal.
All evil spirits of the world shall descend and submit. Furthermore, there is another method:
if one wishes to command hundreds of thousands of millions of kinds of deities, *vajras*, and their like.
Take one jin of mulberry root bark and boil it until it is soft; discard the outer skin.
Seal it with the seal.
Repeat this after each meal.
Ten thousand ghosts will come together to submit; their omens and communications shall likewise be foretold.
Furthermore, there is another method: take one *śu* of pure sand and seal it with the mudrā.
Those in the four directions who are [bound] shall all be completely liberated. Furthermore, there is another method:
take three *sheng* of well-water at dawn and seal it with this mudrā.
It scatters moisture throughout the four directions, nourishing and benefiting all that is withered and parched. Furthermore, there is another method:
take three *śī* of yellow sand and seal it with the mudrā.
Bury it in the earth;
in one day, it will transform into gold. Furthermore, another method:
take seven strands of hair from a person wearing the seal.
Seal it with the mudrā and cast it upon the ground;
it will transform into black earth. Furthermore, there is another method.
The person wearing the seal takes the snake and seals it with the seal,
applying one seal to each part.
If one takes a snake that has died from this seal, [the patient] will be free from the first stage of leprosy (*kuṣṭha*), fistula (*gaṇḍamālā*), and ailments such as *aśvin* (stiffness or paralysis).
By administering a small amount of the snake [to the patient], they will be cured. Another method:
If a seal-maker seeks to transcend the world,
they should take water and boil it three times;
taking [the essence], they should use it to wash their face and feet for the duration of a short interval.
Emerging from the earth,
a hundred-jeweled lotus flower supports the seal. If anyone seeks to soar through the air,
take three *sheng* of water and empower it one hundred times with this seal.
Upon washing oneself, one immediately leaps up and departs. Furthermore, for one who seeks the arts of the myriad dharmas by generating a vast and great mind:
take one *liang* of Sichuan pepper and boil it with three *sheng* of water.
Seal it with the mudrā three times.
Divide it into three portions.
Consume one portion at dawn.
Take one dose at noon; take one dose during the night.
[The text here is incomplete/corrupt. It is similar to awakening.
Thereupon, one immediately attains thorough penetration of the myriad dharmas.
Above, one knows the Heaven of the Thirty-three;
below, one knows the ninety-two billion worlds, and all suffering sentient beings therein can be fully saved. Furthermore, there is another method:
Take three *liang* of *nāgapuṣpa* (dragon-flower) incense and seal it seven times with the mudrā.
[Then] yakṣas, rākṣasas, and all malevolent spirits...
All gave rise to wholesome minds and served their preceptors; furthermore, they all took refuge [in the Triple Gem]. Another method:
take one *jin* (catty) of cow-ghee.
Practice holding it in a white porcelain bowl;
regardless of the quantity,
seal it with the mudrā.
Take three liang daily.
By taking this, one will grow weary of this body,
thinking, "I have been beset by evil thieves."
By sacrificing one's body through acts of self-abandonment, one will be reborn before the Buddha in a future life. Furthermore, there is another method:
if one takes seven pieces of white stone.
He sealed it with a mudrā and cast it into the water. Thereupon,
the river deities all emerged, leaping forth together.
And all the venomous nāgas likewise take refuge [in him]. Furthermore, there is a method:
by taking the seal, a jeweled pavilion is formed.
World-Honored One!
Before and behind this seal, there were twenty trillion Buddhas,
all of whom attained deliverance through it. If any man or woman of good family...
Simply seek to obtain this seal and wear it while traveling;
when the day is complete, it will also grant [the fruits] of the Buddha... Furthermore, another method:
simply take the seal and seal whatever place is required according to one's wish.
Immediately [the body] becomes ash. As for the seal applied to the entire body of another deceased person, one should [place it] in the mouth... [and so forth].
Seal it with the mudrā;
it will be transformed into ash and dust.
Another method: take a small amount of... [text missing]. Another method.
Take a pine tree and seal it with the mudrā;
it will immediately transform into a flowering tree. Furthermore, another method: take a peachwood staff six feet long and seal it with the mudrā.
When about to depart for wherever one intends to go, according to one's will... [omitted] ...World-Honored One.
As for this seal, I myself have manifested a transformation body and entrusted it to the person before me... [omitted] ...Furthermore, World-Honored One.
If this mudrā is present in a world, it will always be [obstructed by]... [omitted]. Only those who know that there is only the Bodhisattva, the Sovereign, shall obtain it.
The others... saw the World-Honored One.
If anyone should wear this seal, its merit would be such that even two hundred thousand kinds of blessings could not describe it; it has been thus since immeasurable ages past.

If one attains [the state of] □□□□□□□□□□□□, whatever ritual (*dharma*) one intends to perform, one must first pinch the *mūrdhan* (crown) with the thumb and press the eyes apart. If one does not do so, it shall not be accomplished. Furthermore, within the external ritual procedures:
If one performs this rite while grasping [the thumb] as described above, it will not succeed; however, if one acts otherwise, joy will arise and one will be able to accomplish it.
If a practitioner of mudrās [performs this], wherever their mind intends to sit, they shall seal that place with the mudrā.
